prompt:
Create ONE design variant sheet for a prop of a silent hand-drawn animated film. Pure black field (#000000), flat shapes in five roles only (main1, main2, shadow, light, accent), thin pale contour one step lighter than each fill with tapered tips, shadow as a designed shape with two-scale stipple (never a smooth gradient), no text, no labels, no UI, no gradients, no photographic texture, no black outline. Colour script of the shot: deep blues with cream light and one scarce yellow accent #fad204 (radiance blue #0a51fb). The design must separate into movable parts on the black field (each part a closed flat shape) so it can be cut and moved later.
ASSET: the gadget: raw capability, a hybrid universe-simulator machine in the spirit of The Midnight Gospel, familiar parts in an impossible whole, organic and mechanical at once; not a device with buttons, not an orb; its dial is the one emitter; hand-coded today in Gadget.tsx.
LAYOUT: Show the SAME machine twice on one baseline: left dormant, right with its dial open and light pouring out. 16:9 sheet.
REFERENCE ROLES (each image supplies only the property named; do not copy any of them):
Image 1: Dr. Seuss Midnight Painting: swooping organic lobes, curling stalks with flag leaves and pale thin contour on black.
Image 2: Dr. Seuss Midnight Painting: curling stalks with flag leaves.
Image 3: owner card MFJFTELGH6FD8: a single radiant core behind a flat silhouette, the shape never whites out.
Image 4: the Clawd companion: take only its stubby blocky body, flat plates and small dark slit marks as the cast property.
VARIANT muse-01 'Clock-stalk machine': Stacked blobby lobes like a clock-stalk with a crooked funnel, a curled antenna with a flag leaf, a round dial as the emitter and stub legs. The design sits between clawd (stubby plated legs and body blocks) and the Seuss paintings.
